category_title: Latino/a students who avoid class participation due to fear of embarrassment or social anxiety
minimal_context: The student is expected to participate in a whole-class instruction session in a middle school classroom.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Alright everyone, we are going to start our whole-class discussion now. I will be calling on students to answer the questions on the board.

STUDENT: Can I go to the bathroom?

TUTOR: We just started the lesson. Please take out your notebook and get ready to answer.

STUDENT: I don't understand how things work here. I really need to use the bathroom right now.

TUTOR: You need to stay in your seat and participate in the lesson with the rest of the class.

STUDENT: She hates me, and I want to get out of her class. I'm leaving.

options.A: Provide detailed instruction for each specific element of the whole-class activity.
options.B: Allow the student to call on a neighbor, ask a friend, or poll the class.
options.C: Send a clear message to the student regarding the tutor's dissatisfaction with their behavior.
options.D: Make accommodations to help minimize the student's anxiety during the whole-class lesson.
